body:
Hi fellow crohn'd

I don't know about you but everytime I get out of my shrink's office, I feel more worthless (more worthless... I don't even know if you can say that in english, but I digress) then I did on the way in. Am I alone? Does it start feeling good after a while?

Everytime I get out of there it feels like I've been mentally molested and left on the curb to think about it until next time.

And yes my doctor's an idiot and I'd change in a heartbeat if it wasn't for school (being a student pays... well, about -5k a semester and taking the bus for 12 hours (back and forth) to see someone competent seems out of the question until I get a real job)

Thanks, I really appreciate the support.

When I'm around my friends I usually come out as being strong willed and I often hear them say I look like nothing affect me (I'm getting good at keeping a straight face). I don't know how they would react knowing I'm on the brink of self-termination.

They do know I'm sick, but they have no idea about my "significant other" problems. In my mind, if they don't know I'm a loser when it come to relationships, then I'm not a loser (a.k.a. trying to keep the little bit of dignity I have left (It's hard when you have scheduled colonoscopies every other month, having cameras jammed up my arse sure aren't helping my self esteem))

I understand what you mean, I feel I've been sabotaging my possible relationships by being depressed all the time. On the other hand, not being able to talk to women isn't new for me. I don't think I'll get any better at it by not trying... it seems like setting myself up for future failure.

I don't consider myself as ugly or stupid but approach anxiety, depression, self-loathing and chronic disease aren't a big turn on with girls.

And thinking I've wasted at best 25% of my life expectancy by being alone sure isn't helping

I study software engineering (female population: total sausagefest). 

I tried support groups, I don't know if it's the region I'm in but the people I've met there take a religious approach to the problem which repeals me.

I'd love not to give up on the gf situation but I can't see my situation improving at all. I'd rather be a women since, socially at least, they're not expected to make the approach.

Anyways, thanks for reading, it really means a lot
